description: This file contains test code for creating and verifying bug report zips in an Android Cuttlefish environment. It includes functions to generate bug reports, verify the integrity of zipped files, and check if specific files are included in the zip archive. It primarily tests the bug report creation flow and the inclusion of adb bug reports.

methods.name: TestBugReport
methods.description: Main test function that sets up the environment, creates a bug report, and verifies its contents.

methods.name: createBugReport
methods.description: Creates a bug report zip file using the provided host orchestrator service and group name.

methods.name: assertZipIntegrity
methods.description: Checks the integrity of the zip file by attempting to read each contained file.

methods.name: assertAdbBugReportIsIncluded
methods.description: Verifies whether the generated zip archive includes a specific adb bug report file matching a regex pattern.
